title: AEGIS trading-session calendar template, version 1
description: Hand-authored, local-time session template consumed only by tools/generate_calendars.py (AEGIS-013). Not read at runtime -- python/futures/calendars.py never imports this schema or a timezone database; it reads the offline-generated UTC-interval artifact validated by futures_calendar.v1.json instead.

schema_version.description: Mandatory and enumerated: a template written against a future schema is rejected rather than silently reinterpreted.

template.description: The session-template name a Product.session_template field references.

timezone.description: IANA time zone key the block local times are interpreted in. Used only by the offline generator.

holidays.description: ISO dates, in the template's timezone, on which every block is suppressed for the whole calendar day. Full-day closure only -- no partial early-close modelling.

type.description: regular = primary trading-hours session; overnight = extended/Globex-style session that may wrap past local midnight; maintenance = a recurring closed interval, itself classified as MAINTENANCE rather than carved out of another block.

local_end.description: If local_end < local_start, the block wraps past local midnight and ends on the following calendar day. local_end == local_start is rejected (ambiguous zero/24h length).

days_of_week.description: Weekdays (in the template's timezone) the block STARTS on.
